reviews.text: [h1]The Greenening简评 [/h1] [hr][/hr] The Greenening是一款点击放置类游戏，你作为一片云，踏上一场短暂的治愈放置旅程，探索一个苏醒之中的失落世界。洗去灰烬，揭开隐藏其下的秘密，升级各类浇灌能力，让独属于你的温馨宇宙花园肆意生长。最终修复你自己的行星，保护环境，人人有责。 游戏玩法其实就是自动类点击游戏，不过有别于其他挂机类游戏，本作毫无挂机元素，只能够通过鼠标移动来回从而获取到对应的资源，也就是说要玩家全程盯着这款游戏才可以。这是我觉得稍微可惜的地方，不过受限于主题，本作是保护环境人人有责也可以说是情理之中。而游戏玩法则是你是一个云然后洒落水滴，清理灰尘，在灰尘中找到树木，花花草草，还有各种装置等，最后还以他们本色从而获取资源，比如爱心，也就是星球能量，又比如装置能量还有大脑能量，这些都是可以帮助你升级的资源。需要玩家来回刷取。而游戏总共10关，通关即可，并且在后面还有着不同的地方，就是你可以在灰尘中找到各种动物，比如鸽子，蝴蝶等等，用星球能量也可以给这些动物升级。也应了保护星球，保护动物。并且本作最好的地方则是收益会将一部分捐赠给保护协会！真正做到了保护地球，人人有责。 The Greenening可以说游戏性属于还行的一款放置类增量游戏，不过稍有遗憾的是增量起来并不太爽，进入到下一关能爽上一关，但是上一关的资源又几乎不如下一关，而且自动洒水器也可以说是没有太大用。不过玩着玩着还是很容易上头的，因为游戏内还有资源装置和鸽子蝴蝶等等这种发掘性资源，让人玩起来也有一种探索的功能，游戏流程处于中等左右，属于小甜品级别的游戏，总体来说喜欢增量类的玩家可以前来试试！ [quote]欢迎关注 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45531068/]黑白测评[/url] [hr]黑夜显真 白昼辨伪

This game must have a bunch of fake reviews or I am extremely unlucky, I'm leaning towards fake reviews. I say that because it is extremely slow to progress, I'm not sure how you would get through this game in under 5 hours unless you just exploited the game files or something. It was extremely slow clearing stages, right now I want to finish this dang game but I am missing 1 collection item that I don't know how to get. I'm bored out of my mind re-farming levels to find this collection item to finish the game. The discussions don't seem to mention how to find them all, just random, good luck to you information. Half my gametime is AFK - but the other half is actively playing. This is a very slow to progress incremental, I did not have a good time farming this game out. I am positive the reviews are fake, mostly because you go to look at these people who said it took 2-3 hours to get all the achievements and their profiles are either private or they're hiding the information about their game statistics. High SUS level. Now I could just be extremely unlucky, which is possible, but I don't know, you be the judge. Also, this game is extremely unoptimized, I have a small 24GB 3090 and it runs at 80%+ GPU usage. Eh... Please, end my suffering, I would like to complete this game and move on.

短单局的增量式的挂机游戏。一次又一次的刷新记录，升级技能树。游戏在局内不需要很多的点击，只需要移动鼠标来控制雨水自动滴落的位置清理灰尘。等到物品周围的草地被完全浇透，物品就会完全显现。同时提供一大堆的知识点。等到灰尘去尽，美丽的绿色草地和上面所有的造物完全显现，一块区域就算通关了。 总共有九块区域，会逐步的增加各种新内容。比如说干扰性机械，能恢复水量的水坑，辅助小动物等等。全部通关后，还有比较禅意的额外区域10，在这里就算完成了百分百绿化，也能继续下去。只要你还有水量剩余。 前期的话雨水重复滴落在已清理的区域没有任何作用。不能完全的放养挂机呢。后期技能点上去了，可以把鼠标放在植物上稍微挂一会。植物受到雨水的滋润也会增植。水滴也会飞溅至全场。自动洒水器能自动洒水。花园里的植物就算不在局内也会持续性的产生收益。

TL;DR: Too hard on your PC, upgrades aren't clear enough [b] DO NOT PLAY IF YOU CARE ABOUT GPU USAGE! [/b] The game needs better optimization desperately. I'm not an expert, but my computer shouldn't be sweating bullets over a game about saving the environment. Also, some upgrades feel like a scam. [spoiler] How was I supposed to know the animals need to rest? How was I supposed to know the charge ability was limited? [/spoiler] The game could overall benefit from simply giving you more information. By the way, sorry if I came off as heartless, I just don't sugarcoat it. Don't waste your time, and just donate to charity yourself instead.

One dev? ONE DEV?! How dare you be this talented. Listen. I bought this game expecting a cute little cloud simulator. What I got was an emotional journey where I, a floating cotton ball with attitude, single-handedly fixed a dead planet. No pressure. The Greenening is absurdly relaxing. You float, you rain, you turn grey wastelands into a botanical orgy. The music makes you feel like you're having a spa day in space, while the idle mechanics sneakily hook into your brain like "just one more upgrade... okay maybe ten more". And get this – it's made by ONE PERSON. Erik, if you're reading this: who hurt you? And also, thank you. This game has no right to be this polished, this charming, and this addictive. If you like nature, chill vibes, or pretending you're saving the planet because real life is too complicated – buy this. Your inner child will hug you. Your stress will leave. Your plants will finally understand you. 10/10 would rain on dead rocks again. Waiting for second part! :D

Not gonna lie, this game came to my attention because the developer posted on TikTok saying no YouTubers were covering it and I felt like I had to do something about that. [h3]The Big PSA[/h3] Real quick — this is [b]NOT a true idle game[/b]. You can leave it running and earn some energy passively, but you cannot complete it AFK. You gotta actually play. Just wanted to get that out there first. [h3]The Vibe[/h3] What it IS is a genuinely cozy, no-pressure experience. You're washing ash off a dead planet trying to bring it back to life. There is way more depth here than it looks like at first glance: [list] [*] A solid upgrade tree [*] A garden mechanic [*] Hidden machines & collectibles [/list] One developer made this whole thing. [b]ONE person.[/b] For $4.99. [h3]The Verdict[/h3] [b]Pros:[/b] Incredibly relaxing, great progression, amazing value. [b]Cons:[/b] My only complaint is I wanted WASD movement when zoomed in and it's not there. Not a dealbreaker, but my hands wanted it. [b]Score: 8/10[/b] If you like relaxing cozy games, skip a Starbucks this week and grab this instead. [i]If you want to see the full gameplay before buying, I did a deep dive review here:[/i] https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Kxv8l2bV8Qc

🤍Works on Steam Deck and has 🎮 support. 🤍Cute graphics. 🤍Intriguing story. 🤍Achievements/Completionist 💔Not an actual idle game. It has 1 idle aspect which require growing/finding plants to gather energy to put points into a portion of the skill tree. It takes longer to idle for just energy than playing the actual game to gather the energy, parts and knowledge for the other parts of the tree. 💔This game doesn't have a tag for clicker but it should as it requires lots of clicking to upgrade and/or movement to "water" which is the main part of the game. Not much in ways to automate anything either so mostly hands on. 💔The progression on some parts are really slow, repetitive, and boring. It's the same environment every time aside from a small "garden" biome to grow plants and put some found logs and rocks. 💔Not worth the asking price of 4.99$ or even on sale for 3.99$. This feels more like an under 1$ type game.

A short, fun incremental game, in the same general category of Nodebuster and its like. Same loop as those games - an active stage, then a sprawling upgrade tree with multiple currencies, then back to the active stage. It's not an idle game at all, despite the tag (many devs lump idle and incremental together, and while many are both, some games are only one or the other), but that's my only complaint, the mistagging. Otherwise, it's a short game that doesn't overstay its welcome, only has a small amount of grinding or waiting, and was enjoyable to complete. It's not complex - don't go into this game looking for puzzles or figuring out the most efficient path - just get it if you want something entertaining for a few hours.
